title: Fit Farms
subtitle: Organic Farm-to-Door D2C Ecommerce Experience
description: High-converting modern web platform for fresh organic harvest subscription boxes with instant checkout, smart bundle builder, and recipe discovery.
longDescription: Engineered a custom high-performance Next.js storefront for Fit Farms, delivering a 100/100 Lighthouse performance score and increasing recurring harvest box subscriptions by 48%. Features real-time inventory management, automated customer re-ordering, and responsive design with smooth auto-scrolling preview showcases.

architecture.overview: Ultra-fast headless commerce architecture with edge-rendered static product catalogs and instantaneous client-side navigation.
architecture.challenge: High cart abandonment rates caused by slow image loads and complex multi-step checkout processes.
architecture.solution: Implemented automated WebP image optimization, 1-click Stripe express checkout, and fluid interactive product customization.

title: Cine Media Studio
subtitle: Luxury Production & Commercial Filmmaking Agency
description: Cinematic portfolio and high-converting client acquisition portal for a premier commercial production and brand documentary studio.
longDescription: Built an immersive visual portfolio for Cine Media Studio, featuring video showreel embeds, dynamic client proof grids, and an interactive project inquiry estimator. Elevated brand perception and boosted high-ticket client contract inquiries by 320%.

architecture.overview: Edge-cached Next.js application with progressive video streaming and GPU-accelerated micro-interactions.
architecture.challenge: Heavy 4K video assets slowing down initial page render and mobile responsiveness.
architecture.solution: Implemented adaptive video bitrate streaming with HLS and lazy-loaded WebGL canvas filters.
highlights: Zero layout shift responsive video showcases
Interactive inquiry and project scope budget estimator

title: Aura Botanical
subtitle: Artisanal Organic Skincare & E-Commerce Flagship
description: Minimalist luxury e-commerce experience for handcrafted cold-process botanical soaps with ingredient transparency and custom bundling.
longDescription: Designed and developed an editorial-grade online store for Aura Botanical. Built around tactile earth tones and crisp typography, the experience highlights raw organic botanicals, increasing average order value (AOV) by 35% within 60 days of launch.

architecture.overview: Headless Shopify architecture powered by Next.js App Router and edge caching.
architecture.challenge: Balancing rich editorial photography with instantaneous product filtering and cart drawer speeds.
architecture.solution: Optimized multi-layer image caching with Next/Image and optimistic cart state management.
highlights: Optimistic cart drawer with one-tap checkout
